The '''Werania system''' was located within the [[Biivren sector/Legends|Biivren sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the items known as [[Weranian holocard]]s.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Weranian holocard]]s|system=Werania [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Werania system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />
